en: A monochrome postcard view of a courtyard framed by leafless trees and simple wooden fencing. Historic masonry buildings with tiled roofs, small windows, and decorative stonework surround the yard. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as the economic courtyard of the Fürstenschule St. Afra in Meissen. A red handwritten archival or catalog number appears above the printed caption.
